text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *pant, wheeze, puff*... FuFu~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Blazing fast, super sprint, party timeee!!!
Wooooooaaaahhh☆
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a run free of hesitation. Her tone is pure party-girl,
and her running is pure party-girl. It was delightful to watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A late-blooming potential. Here at last, Mejiro Palmer had undergone yet another transformation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the venue's finally warmed up, so
let's get everyone hyped up even more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Palmer!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the fans who were confused before the race
are completely won over now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With her party-loving running style, Mejiro Palmer captured everyone's hearts completely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaah~, that felt sooooo gooood!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nice vibes, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer, Helios!
This right here, this is what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Blowing right through the pressure,
look at this run! Look at these moves! This is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That you're alive!
Life is the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's anything left to scare me!
Let's ride this momentum as far as we can go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, what about it?
choice_data_list: There's nothing you're afraid of, huh?
There's nothing you're afraid of, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nothing... 
My mind's totally blanking out right now anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there is none, there is no need to hold back.
Then our next objective will be—
choice_data_list: Let's head for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tenno Sho...
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A showdown with McQueen~?!
Maybe Ryan will show up too~?
And what's more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is as serious as it gets...
It's one of the races the Mejiro family values most~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're entering? Really?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if you feel up for it.
Yeah, if you feel up to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And you're gonna pull party-animal moves like today's right there?
choice_data_list: Yeah, and it's the perfect stage for it.
Yeah, and it's the perfect stage for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Will she run? Will she come... the 'Tenno Sho (Spring)'?
But on the day itself, without a doubt, absolutely~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Lady Mejiro herself is coming to watch~~~.
And I gotta go full party-animal in front of her?! Seriously~~~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched to gauge Mejiro Palmer's reaction.
I had no intention of forcing her to enter. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is, on the condition that Mejiro Palmer feels positive about running.
As I watched to see how she would respond...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Just thinking about it shaved years off my life...
Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Time to... go out... I guess..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll try entering...
To see how far I can go.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "For real, Palmer-chin...?! You totally nailed it, woo-hoo!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can!
Palmer-chin is invincible! Full throttle at Yodo, too☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Holding back is totally off the table, right?
Go all out and win big! That's the vibeâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this.
Trainer, I'm going to enter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're only the real deal if you can party hard at the Tenno Sho (Spring)! Oooh, I'm gettin' the chills!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer trembles with unfamiliar excitement and fear.
And thus, she decided to head for the prestigious
Tenno Sho (Spring).
